title: docs(changeset): the consumed page-action-row operation changeset no longer says an `api` row beside the update parses (deliberate correction)
body:
Fixes #23498
Clause-②: no

## What this does

Corrects two sentences of the consumed prerelease changeset `.changeset/pre/23332-page-action-row-operation.md` in place. PR #23494 (merged as `ad5a7d7c3`) made both false. No code, no new changeset, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no `content/docs/releases/`, no `.changeset/pre.json`. The frontmatter, the `Clause-②` line, the ADR-0087 registration marker and the BREAKING banner are byte-identical. The diff touches lines 24 and 30 only (`+2 / -2`).

## First measurement: the 18.0.0 GA entry is compiled from `.changeset/pre/`

The card's first step (triage `6171242082`) is measured two ways, on `1f3ac4f524`:

- **Code.** The repo pins `@changesets/cli` 3.0.3. `@changesets/read` 1.0.1 `readChangesets` reads `.changeset/pre/*` as ids `pre/NAME`. `@changesets/assemble-release-plan` 7.0.0 `getRelevantChangesets` drops `pre/` ids only while `preState.mode !== "exit"`. `@changesets/pre` 3.0.0 `exitPre` writes `mode: "exit"`. So on pre-mode exit, every consumed changeset is an input to the GA release plan.
- **Run.** In a throwaway detached worktree (removed afterwards, nothing committed), `changeset pre exit && changeset version` exited 0. Its own notice said: "Please also review the changesets in the .changeset/pre folder as they will be used as changelogs for the normal versions". The output set `packages/spec` to `18.0.0`. Its `CHANGELOG.md` `## 18.0.0` entry (lines 3 to 4266) carried this file's FROM → TO first row at line 3189 and the "What an author now sees" paragraph at line 3195, false sentence included. So the scope does not shrink to the CHANGELOG line.

## The two sentences, BEFORE → AFTER

| # | where | BEFORE | AFTER |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | FROM → TO, first row, "what to write instead" | the same row without `onSuccess`: the runner performs the write … | the same row without `onSuccess`, with no executor key or `'script'` (beside `operation: 'update'` any other executor is refused at that key, D3 `ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules`): the runner performs the write … |
| 2 | "What an author now sees", closing sentence | The same row without `onSuccess` parses unchanged. | That row is also refused at `actionType`, since beside `operation: 'update'` an executor other than `'script'` is refused (D3 `ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules`); without `onSuccess`, and with no `actionType` or `actionType: 'script'`, it parses. |

**Why:** the example row names `actionType: 'api'`. Since PR #23494, a page action row carries `ActionSchema`'s declarative-update rules, so an executor other than `'script'` beside `operation: 'update'` is refused at the executor key. That holds with or without `onSuccess`. The card's done-line offered two routes: drop the executor from the example, or qualify the sentence. This PR qualifies the two sentences. The quoted refusal text and the example row stay as they were, and the edit stays within the two places the claim names. Nothing about #23332's own semantics changes: `onSuccess` beside the update is still refused whatever executor the row names, or none.

## Every example in the file, parsed against today's `main`

A test-free scratch script (not committed) parsed each shape against `packages/spec/dist/ui` built from `1f3ac4f524`. The branch's later merge of `origin/main` brought in no `packages/spec` change (0 paths).

```text
E1 button {actionType:api, operation:update, patch, onSuccess}: REFUSED (2)
   at ["actionType"] `operation: 'update'` is performed by the platform action route … so `actionType` names that route or noth…
   at ["onSuccess"]  An `action:button`'s `onSuccess` (`operation: 'update'`) would follow a result the contract does not declare: the console's action runner reads `operation` befo…
E2 button {actionType:api, operation:update, patch}: REFUSED (1)   (the row the old closing sentence said "parses unchanged")
   at ["actionType"] `operation: 'update'` is performed by the platform action route …
E3 button {operation:update, patch, onSuccess}: REFUSED (1)  at ["onSuccess"]
E4 button {operation:update, patch}: PARSES
E5 button {actionType:script, operation:update, patch, onSuccess}: REFUSED (1)  at ["onSuccess"]
E6 button {actionType:script, operation:update, patch}: PARSES
E7 member {type:api, operation:update, patch}: REFUSED (1)  at ["actions",0,"type"]
E8 member {type:script, operation:update, patch, onSuccess}: REFUSED (1)  at ["actions",0,"onSuccess"]
E9 member {operation:update, patch}: PARSES
E10 button {operation:delete}: REFUSED (1)  at ["operation"] `operation: 'delete'` is a bulk-def operation with no row-level form …
E11 button {operation:custom}: REFUSED (1)  at ["operation"] `operation: 'custom'` is a bulk-def operation with no row-level form …
E12 button {operation:bogus}: REFUSED (1)  at ["operation"] Invalid input: expected "update"
```

After this PR, every statement in the file matches these results. The FROM → TO first row's "before" is refused (E1). Its "instead" parses (E4, E6, E9). The "What an author now sees" example gets the quoted `onSuccess` text (E1), and the new closing sentence names its second refusal, at `actionType`. The row without `onSuccess` and with no or `'script'` executor parses (E4, E6). The second and third FROM → TO rows match E10, E11, E12 and E4.

## `Check Changeset` is red on purpose: DELIBERATE CORRECTION, and a person's confirmation is owed

`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` refuses a diff that modifies a changeset present on the merge base. Its git pathspec `.changeset/*.md` matches `.changeset/pre/` too. Measured locally: exit 1, `::error file=.changeset/pre/23332-page-action-row-operation.md::`. It names the two classes. This PR is the **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** class: PR #23494 changed the behaviour this pending release note describes. Remedy, per the gate: "do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed". Nothing here is restored or routed around to turn it green. **A person's confirmation of this correction is owed on this PR before it lands**, as on the precedent PR #23126. As on that precedent, no `skip-changeset` label is applied: #23126 carried none, and its gate stayed red until confirmed.

`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`'s `18.0.0-next.1` entry carries the same sentence. It was true at `next.1`, and amending it is the release owner's call. It is not touched here.

## Gates (run at `578a53d33c`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 20 commands. All 20 were run, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (its roster lives under `.changeset/`). `--ran` reconciliation: "20 derived, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a DERIVED zero, with every exit code recorded. Exit 0 for all except `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, which exits 1. That is the designed DELIBERATE CORRECTION red above. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0. `check:nul-bytes`: OK. A control-byte self-scan of the edited file found no hits.

NOT MEASURED locally: the four type-check lanes the derivation names as CI-only. This diff touches no TypeScript.

## Acceptance notes

- The ADR-0087 marker and the BREAKING banner are left verbatim. The D3 id `ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules` named in the new text is the id of `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts`.
